note: Candidate sounds per ability moment, written by Claude from clip names, vanilla SoundDef use, length and brightness. Nothing here was listened to before it was written; pick by ear in the lab.

Thump cannon impact + psychic pulse, low

AG_GojoRed.note: Charge 0.5 s at the fingertip (the warm-up's last 0.5 s), the fire, the burst where it meets something (8 cells away it arrives 0.4 s after the fire), and the thrown pawn slamming into a wall or landing in the open.

moments.label: Charge
moments.when: 0.5 s: a flat red swirl spins at the fingertip, pink ribbon arcs sweep round Gojo, the orb grows white-hot

moments.label: Fire
moments.when: a pink-white flash at the finger, a red ring; Red flies at 20 cells/s

moments.label: Burst
moments.when: it meets a pawn, a thing or the cell: red wash, white flash, a shock front down its line; the others within 1.5 cells pushed 2 cells

moments.label: Slams into a wall
moments.when: the thrown pawn hits a wall 0.5 cells up: +10 blunt, cracks, a big dust cloud, chunks

options.label: Big hit + small stone building down

moments.label: Lands in the open
moments.when: no wall: the thrown pawn touches down, bounces and skids to 6 cells

AG_GojoHollowPurple.note: After Red's charge and fire: Red meets Blue and they merge (0.35 s), the ignition, the growth (0.3 s), the travel (a sustainer the code ends when it fades: 2.3 s for the sketch's 14 cells, 5 s for 30), a touch for each pawn it meets, and the fade.

moments.label: Red meets Blue
moments.when: 0.35 s: the red orb and the blue sphere spiral round each other and in; the world splits red and blue, then darkens

moments.label: Ignition
moments.when: a white point and flash, a purple wash 18 cells across, 4 ripple rings, rays; the biggest shake; Purple grows to 1.5 cells

options.label: Mech band shockwave + mortar dry, low (Biotech)

moments.label: Travel
moments.when: 6 cells/s erasing a 3-cell lane: lightning crackles off it, a ripple ring and a small shake every 0.5 s

options.label: Synth: black flame, low (a crackling roar)

moments.label: Touches a pawn
moments.when: a white flash; on the centre row the pawn dissolves into specks drawn into it, on a side row it takes 60 and falls

moments.label: Fades
moments.when: it breaks into specks and fades in 0.5 s, a last ring; the dim lifts

options.label: Synth: out of the swirl, slow

AG_GojoUnlimitedVoid.note: Home map: the hand sign (0.6 s), the barrier closing (0.3 s) and shrinking into a ball (0.5 s), the ball breaking at the end. Pocket map: the rush in, the black hole opening at 1.35 s, the void's drone for the 10 s (a sustainer the end stops), a touch for each pawn Gojo spares, the collapse (0.7 s). The game plays a sound only on the map the camera is on.

moments.label: Hand sign
moments.when: 0.6 s: a hand rises, fingers cross, the blindfold comes down, the eyes light blue, light gathers at the hand

moments.label: Barrier closes
moments.when: a dark sphere spreads over 9 cells in 0.3 s, everyone under it is taken, then it shrinks into a black ball over Gojo in 0.5 s

options.label: Psychic pulse psycast + mortar, very low (Royalty)

moments.label: Ball breaks
moments.when: home map, at the end: cracks of light, a soft white flash, a ring out to 9 cells; everyone back 0.2 s later

moments.label: Rush in
moments.when: pocket map: white, then speed lines rush out of the point for 1.6 s and the stars fly in

moments.label: Black hole opens
moments.when: a white light at the point, then the black hole opens over 0.7 s, its ring of gas turning

options.label: Mortar dry, very low (a far boom)
Thump cannon, very low + soothe pulser

moments.label: The void (10 s)
moments.when: the whole domain: navy space, stars, the black hole turning; everyone frozen

moments.label: Gojo spares a pawn
moments.when: 0.3 s next to a frozen pawn: a blue ring opens, the specks stop, its colour comes back

moments.label: Collapse
moments.when: pocket map, at the end: the void collapses in 0.7 s, white, everyone goes home

options.label: Shield broken, very low + skip entry
Synth: out of the swirl, low
